cities.name: Tokyo
cities.description: Japan's capital - explore the old-town charm of Yanaka and the coffee scene of Kiyosumi-Shirakawa

neighbourhoods.name: Yanaka/Nezu
neighbourhoods.description: Traditional Tokyo that escaped WWII bombing. Temples, old wooden houses, shopping streets.

neighbourhoods.name: Kiyosumi-Shirakawa
neighbourhoods.description: Tokyo's coffee town. Converted warehouses, specialty roasters, traditional gardens.

neighbourhoods.name: Ebisu
neighbourhoods.description: Sophisticated dining scene, from izakaya to Michelin stars.

cities.name: Kamakura
cities.description: Day trip from Tokyo - temples, Great Buddha, coastal walks

cities.name: Kanazawa
cities.description: Traditional culture preserved - one of Japan's top gardens, geisha districts, samurai houses

neighbourhoods.name: Kazuemachi
neighbourhoods.description: Quiet geisha district along the canal. Traditional atmosphere.

neighbourhoods.name: Higashi Chaya
neighbourhoods.description: Main geisha district. Tea houses, gold leaf shops, traditional architecture.

neighbourhoods.name: Teramachi
neighbourhoods.description: Temple district, residential feel, quieter than tourist areas.

cities.name: Shirakawa-go
cities.description: UNESCO World Heritage village - traditional thatched-roof houses

cities.name: Takayama
cities.description: Preserved Edo-period town in the mountains - Hida beef, sake breweries, morning markets

neighbourhoods.name: Sanmachi Suji
neighbourhoods.description: Historic merchant district. Traditional buildings, sake breweries, shops.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.description: Cultural heart of Japan - temples, gardens, geisha districts

neighbourhoods.name: Nishijin
neighbourhoods.description: Traditional textile district. Machiya houses, local atmosphere.

neighbourhoods.name: Okazaki
neighbourhoods.description: Near museums and Philosopher's Path. Quiet, residential.

neighbourhoods.name: Gion
neighbourhoods.description: Famous geisha district. Best in early evening before crowds.

cities.name: Uji
cities.description: Japan's matcha capital - world-famous green tea, beautiful temples, riverside scenery

neighbourhoods.name: Uji-bashi Area
neighbourhoods.description: Main area around Uji Bridge with tea shops, temples, and riverside walks.

cities.name: Hiroshima
cities.description: Peace Memorial, amazing okonomiyaki, gateway to Miyajima

neighbourhoods.name: Hondori/Nagarekawa
neighbourhoods.description: Central shopping arcade and entertainment district. Good food scene.

cities.name: Miyajima
cities.description: Sacred island with floating torii gate, friendly deer
